facts.business: Bharat Road Network Limited is an infrastructure company engaged in the development, operation, and maintenance of road and highway projects through its subsidiaries and associates, primarily on a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) basis.

auditor.name: M/s. MR & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion on standalone financial statements due to non-recognition of interest on financial assistance from July 01, 2024 onwards, resulting in understatement of loss before tax for quarter ended March 31, 2026 by Rs 884.96 lakhs, overstatement of profit before tax for year ended March 31, 2026 by Rs 4,107.69 lakhs, and understatement of current liabilities by Rs 7,027.26 lakhs. Secretarial audit qualifications include: (i) failure to submit XBRL filings for trading window closure within 24 hours for quarters ended September 30, 2025 and December 31, 2025; (ii) no disclosure made for Vistar Financiers Pvt Ltd shareholding change from 7.25% to 2.60% exceeding 2% threshold; (iii) Chairperson Mr. Santanu Ray did not sign financial results for Q2 and Q3 FY2025-26, signed by Non-Executive Director instead, not in line with Regulation 33(2)(b) of SEBI LODR.

key_risks: Non-recognition of interest expense leading to material misstatement of financial results
Regulatory non-compliances including delayed XBRL filings and missing SAST disclosures
Ongoing litigation and arbitration in multiple SPVs (Kurukshetra, Mahakaleshwar, Guruvayoor, Solapur)
CBI/ED investigations and asset freezing at Guruvayoor Infrastructure Pvt Ltd
Corporate insolvency resolution process initiated against Solapur Tollways Pvt Ltd leading to loss of control
Impairment of investments in associates and subsidiaries (Kurukshetra: Rs 4,835.38 lakhs; Solapur: Rs 23,116.44 lakhs + receivables Rs 2,286.30 lakhs)
Sub-judice matters with NHAI arbitration awards challenged in courts
IL&FS group dues and receivables under litigation at NCLT
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are primarily with subsidiaries and associates, in the normal course of business, at arm's length basis, with no potential conflict with the interest of the Company at large. Details disclosed under Note No. 29.1 in Notes to Financial Statements as per Ind AS 24. A summary statement is periodically placed before the Audit Committee for review and approval. The Company has a Related Party Transactions Policy available on its website.
